events.title: Random Encounter Rework and Key Binds (Update v0.64)
events.summary: Getting ready for Steam Next fest with a major update to random encounters. Now there are more reasons to engage with random encounters with a variety of new locations, and encounter types.

events.title: Update v0.53.03
events.summary: Version: v0.53.03- Fixed an issue where animals made noise while dead.- Fixed an issue where the player coould not complete the "Prove your worth" quest.- Fixed an issue where the teleport overlay could become stuck and no longer disapear.

events.title: Update v0.53.02
events.summary: Version: 0.53.02- Fixed an issue where mouse sensitivity was not being saved between levels.- Added FOV slider option to the settings.- Added button to reset settings to default.- Added audio to the grapnel hook.- Remapped flashlight key to Shift-C.

events.title: Update v0.53.01
events.summary: - Fixed an issue where players would fall through the world when moving between passages.- Replaced dog hostile sound to make less repetitive. NOTE: If you had issue #1. You might need to select "Revivify" from the pause menu when you run into this problem. After that, it should be fixed for you.
